article.linkText: Big Ten matchup features No. 14 Oregon squaring off against Michigan State
article.story: No. 14 Oregon (7-3) at Michigan State (3-7), Nov. 20 at 8 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Oregon by 15.5. Against the spread: Oregon 5-5, Michigan State 5-4-1. How to watch: FOX Key stats Oregon Offense Overall: 426.5 yards per game (30th in FBS) Passing: 291.0 yards per game (14th) Rushing: 135.5 yards per game (98th) Scoring: 33.8 points per game (26th) Oregon Defense Overall: 343.3 yards per game (50th in FBS) Passing: 209.5 yards per game (66th) Rushing: 133.8 yards per game (52nd) Scoring: 20.6 points per game (33rd) Michigan State Offense Overall: 297.1 yards per game (134th in FBS) Passing: 188.0 yards per game (107th) Rushing: 109.1 yards per game (125th) Scoring: 18.8 points per game (129th) Michigan State Defense Overall: 336.5 yards per game (41st in FBS) Passing: 203.7 yards per game (54th) Rushing: 132.8 yards per game (50th) Scoring: 23.3 points per game (59th) Michigan State ranks 82nd in third down percentage, converting 38.7% of the time. Oregon ranks 22nd on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 32.4%. Michigan State is 98th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 88.2% of trips. Oregon's red zone offense ranks 25th, scoring on 91.1% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Oregon Passing: Dylan Raiola, 1,695 yards, 15 TDs, 2 INTs, 66.2 completion percentage Rushing: Dierre Hill Jr., 572 yards on 117 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Dakorien Moore, 702 yards on 55 catches, 8 TDs Michigan State Passing: Alessio Milivojevic, 1,559 yards, 7 TDs, 3 INTs, 65.1 completion percentage Rushing: Jaziun Patterson, 327 yards on 76 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Chrishon McCray, 414 yards on 39 catches, 1 TD Last game Oregon defeated Michigan 31-7 on Nov. 14. Raiola led Oregon with 341 yards on 20-of-28 passing (71.4%) for four touchdowns and no interceptions. Hill had 98 rushing yards on 21 carries, adding one reception for 49 yards and one touchdown. Jeremiah McClellan had four receptions for 105 yards and one touchdown. Michigan State fell 21-14 to Washington on Nov. 14. Cam Fancher threw for 134 yards on 14-of-22 attempts (63.6%) with one touchdown and one interception. Brandon Tullis had 82 rushing yards on 21 carries, adding three receptions for 23 yards. Fredrick Moore had four receptions for 66 yards. Next game Oregon hosts Washington on Nov. 28. Michigan State plays at Rutgers on Nov. 28.
